info.description:
## Overview

The BeenVerified Append API enriches a person record with contact and identity data. Provide one or more identifying inputs — email, phone, name, or address components — and receive matching people with available names, addresses, emails, and phone numbers.

### Authorization

To access the BeenVerified API, you'll first need to generate an API Key via the [BeenVerified web app](https://www.beenverified.com/rf/dashboard/api). Note the full key is only visible upon initial generation and cannot be retrieved later, so it's crucial to save it immediately.

Include the full key as a Bearer Token in the `Authorization` header of your API requests:

```http
Authorization: Bearer ltvbvtestkey1.testkey1secret
```

#### API key format

Each key is a single token made up of two dot-separated segments:

| Segment | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Public key | Identifies your account. BeenVerified keys begin with `ltvbv`. |
| Private key | Secret used to authenticate the request. |

Requirements:

- The header value must begin with the string `Bearer` followed by a single space.
- The token must contain exactly one `.` separating the public and private segments.

#### Authentication errors

Requests with a missing or invalid API key return `401 Unauthorized` with a JSON body:

```json
{"errors":["API key required"]}
```

```json
{"errors":["Authorization Header must begin with 'Bearer '"]}
```

```json
{"errors":["API key is malformed"]}
```

A `401` response can also indicate an account issue such as insufficient credits or disabled API access after the key has passed format validation.

### Billing and Retries

Successful requests are billed, including those that return no match — unmatched requests return blank fields rather than an error. Requests that return a 500 error are automatically retried and are not billed.

### Rate Limits

There is no hard rate limit, but upstream data sources may throttle requests. We recommend pacing at or below ~100 RPS.

post.description: Return contact and identity information for a person given one or more identifying inputs (email, phone, age, name paired with one of those, or a complete address of street, city, and state).

400.description: When invalid or incomplete input is given

401.description: When the account does not have enough credits, does not have API access, or is otherwise unable to access certain account features. If you believe you are receiving this response erroneously, please contact us at apisupport@beenverified.com.

413.description: When the request body exceeds the allowed size limit

500.description: When there is an issue with the server and the request cannot be completed. If you believe you are receiving this response erroneously, please contact us at apisupport@beenverified.com.
